parse_benchmark_name: parse a gRPC microbenchmark name string into its template and dynamic arguments
numericalize_size_string: convert size abbreviations like 100M or 10k into numeric float values
expand_benchmark_json: expand a gRPC microbenchmark JSON result into flattened row records with context
expand_benchmark_json_with_comparison: expand two benchmark JSON results merging timing data from a second run
review_BM_SPECS: review the benchmark specification dictionary mapping benchmark names to template and dynamic argument lists
